title: Weft corpus
description:
This repository preserves, word for word, the original discovery sessions behind ML Weft: about sixty documents, the full browser-session transcripts, and five interactive widgets exported from the sessions.

It is source material, not instructions. The sessions often narrate commands running, contracts being deployed, and hardware being driven; none of that happened, and there is no Weft token and nothing is deployed on any chain.
